metadata.description: Azure region for APIM and supporting resources.
Name of the API Management instance.
APIM publisher display name.
APIM publisher contact email.
Microsoft Foundry / Azure OpenAI resource name.
Subscription that contains the Foundry resource. Defaults to the APIM deployment subscription.
Resource group that contains the Foundry resource.
Backend base URL. Defaults to the standard Azure OpenAI hostname for foundryAccountName; override for a different endpoint.

Optional: additional Foundry accounts to form a load-balanced, circuit-broken backend pool. Each entry: { accountName, backendBaseUrl, subscriptionId?, resourceGroup?, priority?, weight? }. When non-empty, requests route through a pool named foundry-backend and every listed account must expose equivalent deployment names; when empty (default), the single primary backend is used. /models still lists the primary account only.
Azure OpenAI-compatible API version to send to the backend.
Data-plane API version used to list Foundry deployments for the /models endpoint.

Foundry project name. When set, the /models endpoint also lists the project deployments (including managed-compute models like cohere-north-mini-code) via the AI Foundry project data plane, so they appear automatically without extraModelIds.
API version for the AI Foundry project deployments listing used by /models.
Extra model ids to merge into the live /models list. A manual safety net for deployments that are callable but not returned by the live deployment listings.

Optional managed online endpoint (for example Cohere) base URL, ending at the score API version, for example https://<endpoint>.<region>.inference.ml.azure.com/score/v1. Orgs listed in cohereOrgs route here instead of Foundry.
AAD token audience for the managed online endpoint. Azure ML online endpoints accept tokens issued for https://ml.azure.com.
Org slugs that route to the managed online (Cohere) endpoint instead of Foundry. Must be a subset of orgs; requires cohereBackendBaseUrl.
Model ids advertised on /models for Cohere orgs. The managed endpoint does not expose a Foundry-style deployments listing, so ids are declared here.

Optional managed-compute (Azure ML online endpoint) base URL, ending at the score API version, for example https://<endpoint>.<region>.inference.ml.azure.com/score/v1. Orgs listed in mcOrgs route here. Distinct from the Cohere slot so it can use a different audience.
AAD token audience for the managed-compute endpoint. Azure ML online endpoints accept tokens issued for https://ml.azure.com.
Org slugs that route to the managed-compute endpoint. Must be a subset of orgs; requires mcBackendBaseUrl.
Model ids advertised on /models for managed-compute orgs (the endpoint has no deployments listing).
Organization slugs. Defaults to the keys in orgKeys; override to deploy a subset. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

Optional per-org model allowlist, keyed by org slug -> array of model ids that org may see and call. An org listed here has its /models filtered to these ids and any chat/responses request for another model rejected with 403. Orgs omitted (or mapped to an empty array) are unrestricted.
Model deployment ids whose Chat Completions requests must use the default temperature of 1. Use for models that reject sampling temperatures sent by clients such as VS Code.
Per-org client keys, keyed by org slug. Clients use the gateway HTTPS hostname with /byok/<slug>. Provide via a secure params file or Key Vault reference.
Per-org rate limit: maximum calls per renewal period, counted independently per org.
Per-org rate limit renewal period, in seconds.

Per-org tokens-per-minute overrides, keyed by org slug. Overrides tokensPerMinuteDefault for the listed orgs.
Default monthly token quota applied to every org unless overridden in orgMonthlyTokenQuota. 0 disables the quota. Exceeding it returns 403 until the month resets (UTC).
Per-org monthly token quota overrides, keyed by org slug.
Deploy observability (Log Analytics + Application Insights) and wire an APIM Application Insights logger. Required for enableTokenMetrics.
Existing Log Analytics workspace resource id to reuse for Application Insights. When empty and deployObservability is true, a new workspace is created.

Name for the Application Insights resource created when deployObservability is true. Defaults to <apimName>-ai.

Grant the APIM identity Monitoring Metrics Publisher on Application Insights. Off by default: token metrics reach App Insights customMetrics via the logger connection string without it. Enable only to publish to the Azure Monitor custom-metric store, and only where the standard built-in role id resolves.

Existing Azure AI Content Safety endpoint (https://<name>.cognitiveservices.azure.com) to reuse instead of deploying one. The APIM identity must already have Cognitive Services User on that resource.
Name for the Content Safety resource created when deployContentSafety is true. Defaults to <apimName>-cs.

Enable Prompt Shields (jailbreak / prompt-injection detection) in the content safety check.
Content safety severity scale used for category thresholds.
Reject requests whose Hate severity is at or above this threshold. Range depends on contentSafetyOutputType.
Reject requests whose SelfHarm severity is at or above this threshold.
Reject requests whose Sexual severity is at or above this threshold.
Reject requests whose Violence severity is at or above this threshold.

Deploy Azure Managed Redis (with RediSearch) + an APIM external cache and enable llm-semantic-cache on /chat/completions only. Requires an embeddings deployment on the Foundry account (embeddingsDeploymentName).
Name for the Azure Managed Redis cache created when deploySemanticCache is true. Defaults to <apimName>-redis.
Azure Managed Redis SKU for the semantic cache (for example Balanced_B0).
Embeddings deployment name on the Foundry account, used to vectorize prompts for semantic cache lookup. Required when deploySemanticCache is true.
Semantic cache similarity score threshold (0.0-1.0, as a string). Lower is stricter; values above 0.2 risk cache mismatch. Start conservative.
Cached response TTL in seconds for llm-semantic-cache-store.
Skip caching once a chat dialog has more than this many messages (long multi-turn threads cache poorly).
Enable semantic caching for every org by default. Per-org overrides in orgSemanticCacheEnabled win. Applies to /chat/completions only.
Per-org semantic cache enablement overrides, keyed by org slug (true/false).
Deploy Application Gateway (WAF_v2) and require requests to traverse it. Enabled by default and incurs Azure charges. Set false explicitly for APIM-only deployments without WAF.
Application Gateway name. Defaults to <apimName>-appgw.

Existing Application Gateway subnet NSG in this resource group. Empty creates <appGwName>-nsg. Set this before upgrading a deployment with a governance-owned NSG; only its application client rule is managed.
Shared secret injected by Application Gateway and validated by APIM. Required when deployAppGateway is true; use at least 32 characters. Generate once and reuse on redeployment.
WAF mode for the Application Gateway. Start in Detection for an LLM gateway, tune false positives on chat prompts, then switch to Prevention.
Instance count for the Application Gateway.
Enable HTTPS with HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect. Defaults to true when a PFX is supplied. Requires deployAppGateway and both certificate parameters; set false only for bootstrap or testing.
Base64-encoded PFX (full chain) for the App Gateway HTTPS listener.
Password protecting the PFX in appGwHttpsPfxBase64.
Optional: also restrict APIM inbound to this IP via ip-filter (typically the App Gateway public IP, known after the first deploy). Leave empty to rely on the X-AppGw-Secret header only.
Optional tags applied to deployed resources.

<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <!-- Account-level (OpenAI-format) deployments. Reliable, cognitiveservices audience. -->
    <send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="acctDeployments" timeout="20" ignore-error="true">
      <set-url>{{foundryDeploymentsUrl}}</set-url>
      <set-method>GET</set-method>
      <authentication-managed-identity resource="https://cognitiveservices.azure.com" />
    </send-request>
    <!-- Project deployments (AI Foundry data plane). Adds managed-compute models that do not
         appear in the account listing. Skipped when no project is configured. -->
    <choose>
      <when condition="@(!"{{foundryProjectDeploymentsUrl}}".Equals("https://disabled.invalid", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))">
        <send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="projDeployments" timeout="20" ignore-error="true">
          <set-url>{{foundryProjectDeploymentsUrl}}</set-url>
          <set-method>GET</set-method>
          <authentication-managed-identity resource="https://ai.azure.com" />
        </send-request>
      </when>
    </choose>
    <choose>
      <when condition="@((context.Variables.ContainsKey("acctDeployments") && ((IResponse)context.Variables["acctDeployments"]).StatusCode == 200) || (context.Variables.ContainsKey("projDeployments") && ((IResponse)context.Variables["projDeployments"]).StatusCode == 200))">
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="200" reason="OK" />
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body><![CDATA[@{
              var created = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds();
              var data = new JArray();
              var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
              var allow = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
              foreach (var a in "__ALLOWED_MODELS_CSV__".Split(new char[]{','}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)) { var t = a.Trim(); if (t.Length > 0) { allow.Add(t); } }
              if (context.Variables.ContainsKey("acctDeployments")) {
                  var r = (IResponse)context.Variables["acctDeployments"];
                  if (r.StatusCode == 200) {
                      var arr = r.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true)["data"] as JArray ?? new JArray();
                      foreach (var d in arr) {
                          var id = (string)d["id"];
                          if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(id) && (allow.Count == 0 || allow.Contains(id)) && seen.Add(id)) {
                              data.Add(new JObject {
                                  ["id"] = id,
                                  ["object"] = "model",
                                  ["created"] = created,
                                  ["owned_by"] = (string)(d["owned_by"] ?? d["owner"]) ?? "azure-openai"
                              });
                          }
                      }
                  }
              }
              if (context.Variables.ContainsKey("projDeployments")) {
                  var r = (IResponse)context.Variables["projDeployments"];
                  if (r.StatusCode == 200) {
                      var arr = r.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true)["value"] as JArray ?? new JArray();
                      foreach (var d in arr) {
                          var id = (string)d["name"];
                          if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(id) && (allow.Count == 0 || allow.Contains(id)) && seen.Add(id)) {
                              data.Add(new JObject {
                                  ["id"] = id,
                                  ["object"] = "model",
                                  ["created"] = created,
                                  ["owned_by"] = "azure-foundry"
                              });
                          }
                      }
                  }
              }
              foreach (var em in new string[] { __EXTRA_MODELS_JSON__ }) {
                  if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(em) && (allow.Count == 0 || allow.Contains(em)) && seen.Add(em)) {
                      data.Add(new JObject {
                          ["id"] = em,
                          ["object"] = "model",
                          ["created"] = created,
                          ["owned_by"] = "azure-ml"
                      });
                  }
              }
              return new JObject {
                  ["object"] = "list",
                  ["data"] = data
              }.ToString();
          }]]></set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
      <otherwise>
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="502" reason="Bad Gateway" />
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body><![CDATA[@{
              var status = context.Variables.ContainsKey("acctDeployments")
                  ? ((IResponse)context.Variables["acctDeployments"]).StatusCode.ToString()
                  : "no response";
              return new JObject {
                  ["error"] = new JObject {
                      ["message"] = "Failed to list Foundry deployments (upstream status: " + status + ").",
                      ["type"] = "api_error",
                      ["code"] = "deployments_unavailable"
                  }
              }.ToString();
          }]]></set-body>
        </return-response>
      </otherwise>
    </choose>
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>

<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    __AI_CONTENT_SAFETY__
    __AI_CACHE_LOOKUP__
    __AI_TOKEN_GOVERNANCE__
    <set-body><![CDATA[@{
        var body = context.Request.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true);

        var useOpenAiTokenLimit = __NORMALIZE_OPENAI_TOKEN_LIMITS__;
        var legacyMaxTokens = body["max_tokens"];
        if (useOpenAiTokenLimit && legacyMaxTokens != null)
        {
            var maxCompletionTokens = body["max_completion_tokens"];
            if (maxCompletionTokens == null || maxCompletionTokens.Type == JTokenType.Null)
            {
                body["max_completion_tokens"] = legacyMaxTokens;
            }
            body.Remove("max_tokens");
        }

        var model = (string)body["model"];
        var defaultTemperatureModels = new string[] { __DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE_MODELS_JSON__ };
        var requiresDefaultTemperature = false;
        foreach (var modelId in defaultTemperatureModels)
        {
          if (String.Equals(model, modelId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
          {
            requiresDefaultTemperature = true;
            break;
          }
        }

        if (requiresDefaultTemperature && body["temperature"] != null)
        {
          body["temperature"] = 1;
        }

        var tools = body["tools"] as JArray;
        if (tools != null)
        {
            foreach (var tool in tools)
            {
                var fn = tool?["function"] as JObject;
                if (fn != null)
                {
                    var strictToken = fn["strict"];
                    if (strictToken == null || strictToken.Type == JTokenType.Null)
                    {
                        fn["strict"] = false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return body.ToString();
    }]]></set-body>
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    __AI_CACHE_STORE__
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>
variables.policyTemplate:
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    __APPGW_GUARD__
    <!--
      Per-org auth. This policy is templated per organization at deploy time:
        __ORG_KEY_NV__  -> {{byokKey-<org>}}  (that org's secret named value)
        __ORG_SLUG__    -> <org>              (the org slug, used for attribution + throttling)
        __RATE_CALLS__ / __RATE_PERIOD__ -> per-org rate-limit-by-key settings
      The presented key is bound to THIS org's path: a key issued to another org
      fails the comparison here and is rejected with 401, so callers cannot shift
      cost by repointing at a different /byok/<org> URL.
    -->
    <set-variable name="presentedKey" value="@{
        var auth = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Authorization", "");
        return auth.StartsWith("Bearer ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            ? auth.Substring("Bearer ".Length).Trim()
            : "";
    }" />
    <choose>
      <when condition="@(string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)context.Variables["presentedKey"]) || (string)context.Variables["presentedKey"] != "__ORG_KEY_NV__")">
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="401" reason="Unauthorized" />
          <set-header name="WWW-Authenticate" exists-action="override">
            <value>Bearer error="invalid_token"</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body>{"error":{"message":"Invalid or missing API key.","type":"invalid_request_error","code":"invalid_api_key"}}</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
    </choose>
    <set-variable name="byokOrg" value="__ORG_SLUG__" />
    <!-- Capture the requested model once (POST only) for reuse by the allowlist and token metrics. -->
    <set-variable name="byokModel" value="@{
        if (!context.Request.Method.Equals("POST", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return "n/a"; }
        try { return (string)context.Request.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true)["model"] ?? "unknown"; } catch { return "unknown"; }
    }" />
    <!-- Per-org throttling. counter-key is the org slug, so limits are isolated per organization. -->
    <rate-limit-by-key calls="__RATE_CALLS__" renewal-period="__RATE_PERIOD__" counter-key="@((string)context.Variables["byokOrg"])" />
    <!-- Attribution: surfaces the org as a dimension in API Inspector / Application Insights. -->
    <trace source="byok" severity="information">
      <message>@("byok org=" + (string)context.Variables["byokOrg"] + " op=" + context.Operation.Id)</message>
      <metadata name="byokOrg" value="@((string)context.Variables["byokOrg"])" />
    </trace>
    <!-- Per-org model allowlist. When __ALLOWED_MODELS_CSV__ is non-empty, POST requests
         (chat/completions, responses) must name a permitted model or are rejected with 403.
         Empty list = no restriction. GET /models carries no body and is skipped here; the
         /models operation policy filters the advertised list to the same allowlist. -->
    <choose>
      <when condition="@{
          var allow = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
          foreach (var a in "__ALLOWED_MODELS_CSV__".Split(new char[]{','}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)) { var t = a.Trim(); if (t.Length > 0) { allow.Add(t); } }
          if (allow.Count == 0) { return false; }
          if (context.Request.Method != "POST") { return false; }
          var model = (string)context.Variables["byokModel"];
          return string.IsNullOrEmpty(model) || !allow.Contains(model);
      }">
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="403" reason="Forbidden" />
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body>{"error":{"message":"The requested model is not permitted for this organization.","type":"invalid_request_error","code":"model_not_allowed"}}</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
    </choose>
    <set-backend-service backend-id="__BACKEND_ID__" />
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>

variables.appGwGuardTemplate:
<!--
  App Gateway front-door enforcement (injected only when the App Gateway feature is enabled).
  App Gateway adds X-AppGw-Secret to every forwarded request via a rewrite rule set. Because
  the rewrite SETS the header, any value a client tries to supply is overwritten at the gateway.
  A caller hitting the public APIM hostname directly does not carry the secret and is rejected
  with 403, so the WAF cannot be bypassed. __APPGW_IPFILTER__ is optionally replaced with an
  ip-filter that additionally restricts inbound traffic to App Gateway's public IP.
-->
<choose>
  <when condition="@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-AppGw-Secret", "") != "{{appGwSecret}}")">
    <return-response>
      <set-status code="403" reason="Forbidden" />
      <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
        <value>application/json</value>
      </set-header>
      <set-body>{"error":{"message":"Direct access is not permitted; requests must traverse the gateway.","type":"invalid_request_error","code":"gateway_required"}}</set-body>
    </return-response>
  </when>
</choose>
__APPGW_IPFILTER__
variables.staticModelsTemplate:
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <!--
      Static /models response for orgs routed to a managed online endpoint (for example
      Cohere), which does not expose a Foundry-style deployments listing. The advertised
      model ids are injected at deploy time:
        __MODELS_JSON__ -> comma-separated, quoted model id literals
    -->
    <return-response>
      <set-status code="200" reason="OK" />
      <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
        <value>application/json</value>
      </set-header>
      <set-body><![CDATA[@{
          var created = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds();
          var allow = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
          foreach (var a in "__ALLOWED_MODELS_CSV__".Split(new char[]{','}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)) { var t = a.Trim(); if (t.Length > 0) { allow.Add(t); } }
          var ids = new JArray(__MODELS_JSON__);
          var data = new JArray();
          foreach (var id in ids) {
              var name = (string)id;
              if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) { continue; }
              if (allow.Count > 0 && !allow.Contains(name)) { continue; }
              data.Add(new JObject {
                  ["id"] = name,
                  ["object"] = "model",
                  ["created"] = created,
                  ["owned_by"] = "cohere"
              });
          }
          return new JObject {
              ["object"] = "list",
              ["data"] = data
          }.ToString();
      }]]></set-body>
    </return-response>
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>
